title: The Man Who Made All of India Cry With '3 Idiots' Is Finally Coming to Your Streaming Screen
excerpt: Rajkumar Hirani's first-ever series 'Pritam and Pedro' stars Arshad Warsi, Vikrant Massey, and Hirani's own son. It hits JioHotstar on July 3.
body:
Rajkumar Hirani has been making films for two decades, and every single one of them has been a blockbuster. Munna Bhai M.B.B.S., Lage Raho Munna Bhai, 3 Idiots, PK, Sanju — the man has never delivered a flop. Not once. It is a record so absurd that Bollywood statisticians have essentially stopped tracking it.

Now, at 63, he is doing something he has never done before: making a show for streaming.

Pritam and Pedro premieres on JioHotstar on July 3, 2026, and the first details suggest Hirani is bringing exactly the combination of warmth, absurdity, and human storytelling that made his films the kind NRI families watch together every Diwali.

The Reunion Nobody Expected

The casting alone is worth the price of a subscription. Arshad Warsi — Circuit himself, Hirani's most iconic collaborator outside of the Sanjay Dutt-Ranbir Kapoor universe — returns to the Hirani fold for the first time since Lage Raho Munna Bhai in 2006. That is two decades of audiences wondering when these two would work together again.

Joining Warsi is Vikrant Massey, who has quietly built one of Indian cinema's most interesting careers through films like 12th Fail and Gaslight. And then there is the wild card: Vir Hirani, the filmmaker's own son, making his acting debut in the lead role.

The show is directed by Avinash Arun, whose credits include Paatal Lok and the gentle, devastating indie film Killa. If you know Arun's work, you know he can balance the quirky and the profound — a sensibility that aligns perfectly with Hirani's brand.

What We Know About the Plot

Details are deliberately sparse. Pritam and Pedro follows two men — one a traditional, instinct-driven investigator (Warsi), the other a tech-savvy young detective (Vir Hirani) — who are thrown together while investigating a cybercrime case linked to an abandoned ATM.

The teaser, which dropped last week, promised 'humour, mystery, and a whole lot of confusion.' In Hirani's vocabulary, that usually translates to a story that makes you laugh for forty-five minutes before quietly destroying you emotionally. If you have seen 3 Idiots or PK, you know the pattern.

Hirani himself described the project in characteristically modest terms: 'It lets the story breathe — the humour, the warmth, the little moments of madness. Long-format gives me space I never had in two-and-a-half hours.'

Why NRIs Should Be Paying Attention

For the diaspora, Hirani occupies a unique space. His films are not just popular abroad — they are cultural touchstones. 3 Idiots is the film that every Indian engineering student in the US has been recommended by their parents. PK is the film that sparked religious debates at dinner tables from Fremont to Wembley. Sanju divided NRI living rooms between those who thought it was hagiography and those who just enjoyed the ride.

A Hirani series means six to eight episodes of that same sensibility, available to stream at home in Houston or Hounslow. The question for international viewers is JioHotstar access — the platform is available in the US, UK, Canada, and parts of the Middle East, though its international pricing and content library differ from the Indian version.

If you are already subscribed for IPL or Hindi cinema, you are set. If not, this might be the title that finally justifies the subscription.

The Bigger Picture

Hirani joining streaming is not just a personal milestone — it is a signal. The last holdout of India's theatrical-first generation has acknowledged that the future of Indian storytelling includes living rooms, not just multiplexes.

For a filmmaker who has grossed over ₹2,000 crore at the box office, the move is not about money. It is about reach. And for NRIs who have spent years explaining to their non-Indian friends why Rajkumar Hirani is essentially India's Steven Spielberg, Pritam and Pedro might finally be the show they can press play on together.

July 3. JioHotstar. Mark it.
